camel_example: aliyun aidge AiTryOn --region cn-hangzhou --ModelImageUrl 'https://ae01.alicdn.com/kf/S342f0070dc9f4be09a6cbed34e90dc8fs.jpg' --ClothImageUrl 'https://ae01.alicdn.com/kf/S342f0070dc9f4be09a6cbed34e90dc8fs.jpg' --ClothType tops --Resolution 1K --version 2026-04-28 --method POST --force
description_en: Virtual Try-On is an AI algorithm-based image generation API service that replaces the clothing on a model with the garment provided by the user based on the input garment image and model image, while preserving the model's other details and scene details without altering the model's pose, facial features, or other attributes, and achieving realistic and well-fitted clothing placement. Users only need to provide the URL of the original product image to obtain a processed clean image
description_zh: 虚拟试穿是一款基于AI算法的图像生成类API服务，能够依据用户输入的服装图和模特图，将服装替换模特现有服装，保有模特的其他细节和画面细节，不改变模特动作、面容等，且实现服装上身的合理性和适配性。用户只需传入原始商品图URL，即可获得处理后的干净图片
name: AiTryOn

parameters.help_en: The URL of the model image. Only one image is supported. The URL must be a publicly accessible `http`/`https` address. The image must be in JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WEBP format, with a resolution between 256 × 256 and 2049 × 2049 pixels, and a file size of no more than 10 MB.
parameters.help_zh: 模特图片 URL，仅支持1张，必须为 `http`/`https` 公网可访问地址，图像需是JPG、JPEG、PNG、BMP、WEBP格式的，分辨率应在256×256至2049x2049像素之间，文件大小不超过10MB
parameters.name: model_image_url

parameters.help_en: The URL of the clothing image. Only one image is supported. The URL must be a publicly accessible `http`/`https` address. The image must be in JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WEBP format, with a resolution between 256 × 256 and 2049 × 2049 pixels, and a file size of no more than 10 MB.
parameters.help_zh: 服装图片 URL，仅支持1张，必须为 `http`/`https` 公网可访问地址，图像需是JPG、JPEG、PNG、BMP、WEBP格式的，分辨率应在256×256至2049x2049像素之间，文件大小不超过10MB
parameters.name: cloth_image_url

parameters.help_en: The clothing type. If specified, the value must be one of the following: tops/bottoms/dresses/tops_and_bottoms/shoes/hats. If not specified, the system automatically identifies the type
parameters.help_zh: 服装类型，如果上传需要上传tops/bottoms/dresses/tops_and_bottoms/shoes/hats，如果不上传即自动识别
parameters.name: cloth_type

parameters.help_en: The output image resolution. The synchronous API supports only 1K
parameters.help_zh: 输出图片分辨率，同步接口仅支持1K
parameters.name: resolution

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is not returned if the call is successful
Code.description_zh: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数

Data.description_zh: 返回的结果结构体信息

ImageHeight.description_en: The height of the result image, in pixels

ImageUrl.description_en: The URL of the virtual try-on result image

ImageWidth.description_en: The width of the result image, in pixels

Resolution.description_en: The resolution of the processed image

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is not returned if the call is successful
Message.description_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used to uniquely identify a request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID：用来识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values: true and false
Success.description_zh: 是否成功：true 代表成功，false 代表失败
